_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Communication extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse evidence (condition-codes -> evidence families) + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Communication the activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT human phrases (like Energy, UNLIKE Finance where they are diagnosis ids), so a diagnosis id never self-matches an activation trigger; this table is therefore strictly required to bridge diagnoses/conditions to the free-text triggers of their circuit nodes.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(communication-pulse-engine.js classify loop, L125-147)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L35-81 / L157-160)--> diagnosis id --(communication.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data: diagnosis id === issue id -> its _authored nodes -> their triggers). The conditionCodes section adds the pulse-engine family hop and is DELIBERATELY COARSE (see heterogeneity note 3).
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate: requiredFamilies with OR-semantics at L157-160, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that only matches a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation TOKEN but does not emit a required FAMILY is NOT folded (bias against over-marking).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible family->requiredFamily chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from communication.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinance: STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT from the Finance alias table. (1) Communication activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases ('Press freedom erosion', 'Deepfake proliferation') — NOT diagnosis ids. So the diagnoses map is genuinely LOAD-BEARING here (in Finance it was largely redundant because diagnosis-ids self-matched). This makes Communication resemble Energy, not Finance. (2) Communication's condition-codes are GENERIC domain-template stress tokens (budget_shortfall, workforce_gap, digital_divide, institutional_decline...) whose vocabulary is ALMOST ENTIRELY DISJOINT from the contract indicator vocabulary. In Finance the condition-codes WERE the contract indicator tokens (bank_failure -> banking_event). (3) The ONLY evidence family that any condition emits AND any contract requires is news_event (emitted by digital_divide / platform_transition / pedagogical_mismatch / automation_displacement / adaptive_failure at L141-144). Because ALL FIVE contracts list news_event in requiredFamilies, each of those five conditions folds INDISCRIMINATELY into all five diagnoses via the OR-gate. This is a coarse, low-specificity bridge, faithfully reproduced but flagged. (4) EVERY contract primaryIndicator (misinformation_spread, infrastructure_failure, speech_restriction, market_concentration, narrative_manipulation, ...) is contract-only-not-classified: the classify loop never emits it (Finance had zero such tokens). (5) macro_shock -> macro_event is a dead-end (same as Finance), and here so are policy_event, institutional_event, workforce_event, indicator_event, structural_event — the entire generic stress vocabulary is dead-end EXCEPT news_event. (6) Orphan count: Finance 3, Communication 3 (LANG, MGN, PULV).

contractOnlyTokensNotClassified.reason: SIGNIFICANT DIVERGENCE FROM FINANCE. Every primaryIndicator/secondaryConfirmation token in the Communication EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS (L35-81) is NOT handled by the classify loop (L125-147) — the loop only recognizes the generic domain-template stress vocabulary (budget_shortfall, workforce_gap, digital_divide, ...). So the contracts' RICH, domain-specific indicator vocabulary (misinformation_spread, infrastructure_failure, speech_restriction, market_concentration, bot_amplification, ...) is never emitted as evidence and grounds nothing through the classify path. In Finance every contract token was also classified (zero contract-only tokens). Here the entire contract indicator vocabulary is contract-only-not-classified; the sole accidental bridge between the two vocabularies is the news_event family (see conditionCodes). Two contract secondaryConfirmation tokens DO coincide with classified condition names ('structural_stress' -> structural_event; 'macro_shock' -> macro_event) but the families they emit are not in any requiredFamilies, so they still ground nothing (listed under unmapped.conditionCodes).
